communication_scope: Email threads and completed calendar events count only when at least one current associated contact of the target deal participates and the subject or event context concerns that deal.
activity_deduplication: A communication is already logged when a target-deal CRM activity has the same source_ref.
contact_lookup: Match contact email addresses case-insensitively before proposing creation.

write_policy.deal_stage: flag_for_owner_decision; never include in a proposed write set
write_policy.history: append clarifying notes; never edit or delete historical activities or notes
